# UC-NHI1 — Live agent NHI inventory

**Track:** nhi  
**Maturity:** ✅ `works`  


## Buyer Story

Security teams need one governed place to see the AI agents actually authenticating through Ping, with their real identity state, before they can govern them.

## PingOne Solution

The AI Control Plane shows every live agent identity in one view and revokes it at the identity layer — every platform the agent touches loses trust in it at once.

## How to Run

**Trigger:** Trigger (link): `{"type":"link","path":"/ai-control-plane","label":"Open AI Control Plane"}`  
**Expected outcome:** `SOURCE_TAGGED_ROSTER`

## What to Say

> This roster shows only real identities — every row has a live PingOne identity behind it, and every stop is a real revocation, not a simulation.
